cleaning_note: Original upstream data (source: wav2gloss / DoReCo spoken corpus), not cleaned by the team. Known issues: (1) glosses write suffixes as separate tokens ('eat -PST -POL -DECL'), see gloss_affixes_detached; (2) the gold transcription is IPA ('məkəsʰuta'), not a romanization, so transliteration scores are expected to be near zero; (3) spoken data with hesitations and false starts ('찾-'); (4) 113/712 test texts contain archaic Hangul jamo; (5) 25 test texts also appear in train (irrelevant for zero-shot); (6) at least one dev row has the empty placeholder text '[ ]' (no test rows do).
gloss_affixes_note: Scoring re-attaches tokens that start with '-' or '=' to the previous token (and tokens ending in '-' or '=' to the next one) before word-level metrics; morphemes are unchanged. After joining, 648/712 test rows (91%) have the same number of words in transcription and gloss (14% before).
